| `ContentPadding` | `FlareSpacing` | `FlareSpacing.None` | Parameter |  | Horizontal inset on the content region, on the shared FlareSpacing scale - the same steps FlareStack.Gap uses, so a drawer and a stack asking for the same step get the same value from the theme. Vertical padding is unaffected. None (the default) leaves the content full-bleed, because a drawer cannot know what it holds: a nav menu carries its own item insets and wants its state layer to reach the panel edge, while a form wants to sit off the edge and line up with the header. Set it to match the header's own inset (Large in the in-box themes) for the form case. |
